answer: The nebula counter is kept in echo and yarrow reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The per-identity price is 5 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
